subject: Renewal health check — uptake accelerator / capacity proposal
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Park <anna@focalai.com>, procurement@focalai.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal health check — uptake accelerator / capacity proposal

Hi Anna / FocalAI team,

Thanks again for the productive Q&A last week. I pulled together a concise snapshot of current usage and a short proposal that aims to keep your latency SLAs stable while lowering unit costs as you scale. High-level points: 

- Current run-rate (30d average): ~2.8B tokens / month. 60% generation, 40% embeddings.
- Peak window: 220 qps sustained bursts; we observed KV cache miss amplification during concurrent contextual queries which bumped token latency by ~18% at 99th percentile for 95th percentile length.
- Unit economics: effective cost/token improved 6% month-over-month with recent quantized model variant, but forecasted spend is expected to increase ~55% YoY given feature rollout.

Proposal summary (attached): Uptake Accelerator — a 12-month committed capacity add-on that:
1) Reserves an additional dedicated pool equivalent to +25% throughput for burst smoothing.
2) Applies an early-commit credit equal to 8% on top of your existing tier for the first 6 months.
3) Includes a quarterly performance review and a dedicated ops slot for deployment tuning.

Why this helps: the extra pool preserves low-latency routing during peak windows and reduces fallback to higher-latency variants. The commitment credit offsets incremental spend while we instrument better KV caching and batching; net ROI for FocalAI modeled at ~14% NPV improvement over 12 months (see Drive link).

Attached: focalai_q3_usage_report.pdf, latency_slo_violation_chart.png, uptake_accelerator_proposal.pdf
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/record/RWI-2027-045
Drive ROI: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/sales/focalai/roi-recap-2027

Next steps I recommend:
- Quick internal review of the proposal (ops + finance) this week.
- 30-minute call with your procurement to align on PO timeline.
- If agreed, we can lock the 12-month uptick and schedule the rollout window for mid-Oct.

Proposed times: Wed 9/22 10:00-10:30 PT or Thu 9/23 14:00-14:30 PT.

Thanks — happy to hop on a call to walk through the numbers.

--
Priya Natarajan

Priya — thanks for the summary. A couple of operational notes to add before we send to procurement: 

- Ops can front-load the KV-cache tuning as part of the rollout; recommend enabling prefix caching for the 3 top templates first (will reduce effective burst load by ~12-15%).
- We should include a short SLA appendix that clarifies failover behavior when the dedicated pool is saturated — saves confusion later.

I'll draft a one-paragraph ops note and attach it to the proposal. Monica, can you validate the rollout window and whether we need an extended maintenance blackout?

—Ben

Onward — Ben Carter

Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal health check — uptake accelerator / capacity proposal

Thanks Priya — appreciate the concise package. Looping in procurement so we can get clarity on the PO timeline and billing cadence. A few questions from my side before the call: 

1) Can you send an ROI slide that explicitly maps projected spend vs. expected latency improvement (30/60/90 day windows)?
2) What are the exact billing triggers for the committed pool? Is there a ramp credit or true monthly invoicing?
3) Any blackout windows we need to plan for upgrades that might temporarily affect prediction latency?

Also — procurement would like to see an annex listing the data handling assurances for our EU customers (we have a non-trivial EU subset); will Redwood provide that in the package?

We can do Thu 9/23 14:00 PT for the call. If procurement needs additional attendees I can share a calendar invite with details.

Best,
Anna Park
Head of Platform, FocalAI

Anna / team — great, Thu 9/23 14:00 PT works (calendar invite sent). In response to your questions: 

1) ROI slide: attached a 2-slide ROI extract that maps projected monthly spend vs. 99p latency delta at 30/60/90 day checkpoints; you can find the full model at the Drive link.
2) Billing triggers: the committed pool is invoiced monthly; we apply an upfront commit credit that amortizes over the first 6 invoices (see proposal section 2.1). We also included an optional true-up clause at month 6 to rebalance committed units if actual run-rate deviates >25%.
3) Blackout windows: standard practice is a 30-minute rolling maintenance window during low-traffic hours; we will coordinate with your ops to avoid feature pushes. Any required longer maintenance will be scheduled with 72-hour notice.
4) EU data handling: attaching a short annex summarizing our EU data residency and KMS options; for private deployment customers we provide tenant-level keying and region controls.

Attachments: focalai_q3_usage_report.pdf, latency_slo_violation_chart.png, uptake_accelerator_proposal.pdf (ops appendix and EU-annex included within the proposal file).

Action items we own before the call:
- Ben: draft ops appendix and maintenance blackout note (sent to this thread).
- Monica: confirm rollout calendar windows and resource availability.
- Priya: finalize PO template for procurement (I'll attach after the call).

I’ll also add the HubSpot update after we conclude the call (deal RWI-2027-045). Let me know if you need an earlier walkthrough of the ROI slides.

Thanks — looking forward to the meeting.
